question_pt: Como as internacoes com contraceptivo 1 informado se distribuem por tipo de contraceptivo?
next_action: Comparar colunas/linhas esperadas e revisar selecao/agregacao.
generated_sql:
SELECT c.DESCRICAO AS tipo_contraceptivo, COUNT(*) AS internacoes
FROM internacoes i
LEFT JOIN contraceptivos c
  ON i.CONTRACEP1 = c.CONTRACEPTIVO
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY internacoes DESC
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.DESCRICAO AS contraceptivo, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN contraceptivos c ON i.CONTRACEP1 = c.CONTRACEPTIVO GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY internacoes DESC
